caseName: Vickers v. Township Committee of Gloucester Township
caseNameFull: VICKERS v. TOWNSHIP COMMITTEE OF GLOUCESTER TOWNSHIP Et Al.
attorneys: Milford Salny for appellant., M. Cene Haeberle for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
